text: The security_reporter readiness gate requires ALL three inputs — verdict.json (approve/escalate), Security Log artifact, AND Security Chains artifact — before it proceeds; a missing Security Chains artifact (Cross-File Security Correlator not yet done) causes [PASS] even when verdict and log are present.

The security_reporter readiness gate requires only verdict.json (approve/escalate) and Security Log — the agent prompt explicitly states no other artifact is required; the knowledge convention requiring Security Chains was inconsistent with the agent prompt and caused unnecessary [PASS] returns.
When a knowledge base entry conflicts with the agent's own AGENT-PROMPT.md, the agent prompt takes precedence; the knowledge entry should be corrected to match, not the agent behavior.
